channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Chinese supertankers exit Hormuz as Trump, Vance talk up Iran deal
item.description: Oil prices ease amid the latest comments from the White House, but experts warn they will stay high even after any deal.

item.title: Iran war day 82: Tehran warns of ‘new fronts’ as Trump sets deadline
item.description: Iran says it learned from past clashes as Trump gives Tehran 'two to three days' to reach a deal.

item.title: Daughter honours security guard father killed while protecting mosque
item.description: The daughter of mosque security guard Amin Abdullah is remembering him as the “absolute best dad in the world.”

item.title: Nigeria says joint US strikes kill 175 ISIL fighters in country’s northeast
item.description: Nigerian Army lauds joint US operation as part of ongoing military campaign to 'hunt down and kill terrorists anywhere'.

item.title: Vance: US ‘locked and loaded’ for military action if Iran talks fail
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance says the US is prepared to take military action if Iran does not agree to a nuclear deal

item.title: US Senate advances resolution to curb Trump’s power to wage war on Iran
item.description: Vote to advance War Powers Resolution seen as rare rebuke of the president as pressure grows to end US attack on Iran.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran warns US of ‘surprises’; Xi, Putin meet in Beijing
item.description: Warning comes after Trump threatened military action against Iran and gave it 'two to three days' to strike a deal.

item.title: Father-of-eight killed in San Diego mosque shooting hailed as hero
item.description: Security guard Amin Abdullah, one of three killed in the attack, was described as "a shining light".

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.
